profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ NextGen Healthcare | M.S. Computer Science @ Stevens Institute of Technology | Doctor of Medicine @ Lake Erie College of Medicine
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Doctor turned Software Engineer! My name is Greg, and I am a Full-Stack Software Engineer II at NextGen Healthcare, a leading provider of software and services for the healthcare industry. I have over 5 years of experience in developing web and mobile applications with Java, React, Node.js, Python, and other technologies.

I am also a co-founder of two startups, myMedsRec and Poof! API, where I applied my skills and knowledge in computer science and data science to create innovative solutions for medication tracking and automatic purchasing. I am passionate about using technology to improve healthcare outcomes, enhance user experience, and solve real-world problems. I hold a Master of Science Degree in Computer Science and Data Science from Stevens Institute of Technology, and a Doctor of Medicine Degree from Lake Erie College of Medicine.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
● SME, mentor, and code reviewer for one of the engineering teams 
within the company

● Modernized and transitioned legacy fax integration software to a
new provider. Implemented a new processor to utilize third party
APIs to handle the retrigger of dropped faxes

● Wrote requirements, designed, and implemented a paired API and
processor to collate and export bulk health data to meet
requirements for CURES certification; a healthcare regulatory
mandate

● Enhanced healthcare record auditing functionality to allow
concurrent processing using Java. Fixed Oracle SQL database
triggers used to audit healthcare records. Enabled the report of
auditing progress to clients using JavaScript, HTML, and Java
Server Page (JSP)

● Refactored Healthcare EDI file processors to use an
industry-standard claims clearinghouse. Utilized terraform to
create and manage necessary infrastructure to facilitate the
workflow of newly refactored healthcare EDI file processors.
Deployed aforementioned processors to AWS EC2 boxes, and
redesigned them to ingest and upload data to and from AWS S3/SQS

positions.title: Co-Founder / Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
https://github.com/GregmarC/myMedsRecPublic 

● Co-founded myMedsRec App, an innovative and easy to use medication mobile tracking app that also allows for patient to doctor health record information transfer via app generated QR code

● Developed front end mobile app and QR web app with ReactNative and React.js, respectively

● Developed back-end primarily with Python and Flask, with database handled through SQL-Alchemy and PostgreSQL

● Integrated Google and Facebook OAuth to front end login

● Implemented MultiFactor Authentication and working to store Personal Identifying Information (PII) in a secured database (i.e. TrueVault)

positions.title: Co-Founder / Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
● Co-founded Poof API, a service that allows for automatic purchasing off of popular sites such as Amazon, Best Buy, Costco, etc., through the primary use of robotic processing automation.

● Developed front end application for primary Poof! website with React and Node.JS

● Integrated several third party APIs such as Firebase, Stripe, and Redis.

● Continuing to develop multiple features for use with umbrella Poof! app, such as functional chatbots, product, course, and travel comparison sites, and email/text alert services.

positions.title: Recurse Center Participant
positions.description:
● Participated  in a community driven programming workshop/retreat based in New York City, where I learned, coded, studied, and paired with other members of the software development community

● Built and worked alongside fellow coding collaborators from diverse backgrounds and levels of expertise on various coding projects such as, but not limited to, OS development, game development, web development

positions.title: Internal Medicine Resident Physician
positions.description: Managed patients admitted to the hospital floors. Participated in diagnosis, assessment, and treatment plans for patients. Performed several medical procedures, including but not limited to: foley catheter insertion/removal, central line insertion, arterial blood gases, CPR. Created and presented several medical presentations to fellow doctors, students, and faculty.

positions.title: Research Staff Member
positions.locationName: Rutgers, New Brunswick, University College of New Jersey
positions.description:
● Interviewed participants/families with health questionnaires. Diagnosed different psychiatric disorders such as, depressive and manic episodes, dysthymic, bipolar, substance-induced, adjustment, and schizophrenic disorders. 

● Assisted with laboratory maintenance/duties and data entry

projects.title: Jym the App
projects.description:
Through the use of React Native for frontend and AWS alongside GraphQL for backend and database needs, I developed a full-stack mobile app that connects users to nearby fitness trainers, as well as to trainers that are open to virtual training sessions.

Notable implemented features/packages include: React Native Google Places Autocomplete, React Native Google Maps, AWS Authentication

projects.title: Poof! Auto-Compare!
projects.description:
Visit my site at : www.poofpricecompare.com

-Developed a product comparison site as an additional feature for my main Poof! app

-Front end web application developed through the primary use of React and Node.JS

-Incorporated text and email alerts for customer specified products, and currently integrating auto-purchasing functionality
